newsitem.title: USA: ComEd LaSalle nuke to resume output Weds.
newsitem.headline: ComEd LaSalle nuke to resume output Weds.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co's 1,078 megawatt (MW) LaSalle nuclear power unit 1 was expected to resume electricity production on Wednesday after an unexpected shutdown for repairs over the weekend, a company spokesman said Monday.
The unit, located in Seneca, Ill., was expected to startup Tuesday and resume electricity production on Wednesday, September 25, said company spokesman Gary Wald.
The unit was shut down to repair a turbine control valve, the spokesman said.
Separately, ComEd's 794 MW Dresden nuclear power unit 3 resumed production Monday after a refueling and maintenance outage which began June 21, Wald said.
"It came on line early this afternoon and should be up to full power within the next two to three days," he said.
Dresden 3 is located at Morris, Ill.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
